result.keyword: Who are the leading luxury real estate agencies and top-performing auctioneers for prestige residential properties in Australia?

items.markdown:
Australia's leading luxury real estate agencies and high-end specialists include premier international networks and dominant local independents like `Sotheby's International Realty – Australia, Kay & Burton, Marshall White, and Ray White Prestige` . Elite high-end auctioneers such as [Marcus Chiminello](https://agent.domain.com.au/advice/inside-the-playbook-of-australias-top-prestige-agents-1408401/) (Marshall White) and specialized auction houses drive record-breaking prestige residential outcomes.[[1]](https://agent.domain.com.au/advice/inside-the-playbook-of-australias-top-prestige-agents-1408401/)

### Leading Luxury Real Estate Agencies

- Sotheby's International Realty – Australia : Global powerhouse handling multi-million dollar trophy coastal and urban estates.
- Kay & Burton : Elite Melbourne-based agency renowned for high-end heritage and contemporary luxury properties in Victoria.
- Marshall White : Dominant force in Melbourne’s prestige Stonnington and bayside markets.
- Ray White Prestige : Specialized luxury division of the broader Ray White network, featuring high-performing arms like Matt Lancashire's Ray White Collective Luxury in Brisbane.
- Knight Frank Prestige Residential : International advisory and luxury property arm with an extensive high-net-worth client base.
- Abercrombys Real Estate : Boutique high-end firm managing luxury residential transactions across Melbourne and expanding interstate.[[1]](https://luxurylist.com.au/agencies)[[2]](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/australia-luxury-residential-real-estate-market/companies)

### Top-Performing Prestige Agents and Auctioneers

- Marcus Chiminello (Marshall White): Renowned Melbourne director who frequently sets state residential records for high-end properties.
- Matt Lancashire (Ray White Collective Luxury): Leading Brisbane luxury specialist managing multi-million dollar transactions.
- Gavin Rubinstein (TRG): High-profile Sydney prestige specialist handling landmark luxury penthouses and trophy homes.
- AuctionWORKS and leading corporate auctioneers: High-volume, specialized rooms managing competitive high-end bidding sequences in major metro markets.[[1]](https://www.localsearch.com.au/find/auctioneers/sydney-nsw)[[2]](https://agent.domain.com.au/advice/inside-the-playbook-of-australias-top-prestige-agents-1408401/)[[3]](https://luxurylist.com.au/agencies)
